answer: Registration is a batch of twenty under one sponsor and one $12,000 bond, plus a contact who can be subpoenaed. Each epoch the ledger draws one name in two hundred for audit: a recorded interview, source files, and their edit history. Applicants sharing a sponsor, a bank draft or a rehearsed fable fold into one vote; a skipped audit forfeits the bond to the miners it displaced. Nineteen interviews cost $1,600 in reviewer hours, so a thousand identities burn $80,000 before first payout. A sonnet keeps fourteen lines however many hands copy it; an atlas gains no country from a reprint.
